title: Course averages
objective: course_averages(records) takes (student, course, score) tuples and returns the average score for every course.
expected: Return a dict like {"math": 85.0}. Each average is rounded to 1 decimal place. An empty list gives an empty dict.
constraints: A student can appear in more than one course.

advice.diagnosis: Line 7 uses totals[course] += score, which raises a KeyError the first time a course is seen because the key does not exist yet.
advice.rationale: totals.get(course, 0) + score starts each new course at 0, the same way the counts line below already does. The second loop then works unchanged.

prediction.question: After applying the suggested patch, what does course_averages([("a", "cs", 70), ("b", "cs", 75)]) return?
